descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-05 Keeping Data Secure / Real-PHI Readiness Gate · S19 「生产的模型 ID 和 guardrail 和 UAT 运行记录一致」 Production model IDs and guardrail match the UAT run record

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U7 The guardrail configuration (ADDRESS/PHONE = None) and the model ID are version-pinned in production and match what UAT ran on.（UAT OAT-05；UAT 3.1；TFA-94059 AC 6） — gate: blocked: TFA-94059 in progress
  • U9 Each run records which AI ran each step: the note model, the speech-to-text engine (GPT-Live streaming; Deepgram only when ambient is on), and the models for pre-round processing, photo capture and A …（UAT 3.9；UAT 3.1；TFA-94423 AC 7）
  • U3b GPT-live is the active dictation engine on production: aiProvider.transcription is 'gpt-live' (not missing, not 'whisper').（TFA-94423 AC 1；TFA-94423 notes (Daniela 2026-10-09: 'GPT-live only')）

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given The 3.1/3.9 run record of the UAT run, and the same values read on production by Tim

When Compare field by field, as exact strings. aiProvider:_current (provider, model, fallbackModel, visionProvider, visionModel, transcription); BEDROCK_GUARDRAIL_ID and BEDROCK_GUARDRAIL_VERSION; the guardrail's PII actions (S20); the VERTEX_AI_CONFIG project, location and model; the deployed commit. …

Then Every field equals the 3.1/3.9 run record exactly. Production aiProvider.transcription is 'gpt-live', whatever the record says. No aiProvider change has been made since the UAT run.

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT OAT-05 step 7 'match what UAT ran on', TFA-94059 AC 6 and UAT 3.1. Judged on exact string equality with the run record for every field: any difference is a Fail, quoted with the field and both values. U3b is absolute (TFA-94423 AC 1, Daniela 2026-10-09 'GPT-live only'): a missing transcription value or 'whisper' on production is a Fail, quoted with the row, even if the UAT …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 CONFIG · 配置核对；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S19 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-05.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。
